scope: Selected current Win32 normal five-argument updater request. This defines observed lifecycle semantics; it is not a portable execution API.

facts.claim: After argument preparation, get own PID and process creation FILETIME, format Local\POLCN_UpdateHandoff_%lu_%08lX%08lX with PID/high/low, then create manual-reset initially-unsignaled event. Null handle or ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS183 enters failure cleanup.

ShellExecuteExA uses runas/mask0x440/directory from prepared context. Success still requires a returned process handle and SetTimer0x232b at100ms. Handle cleanup is not child-process termination or update commit.

Event present and wait0 ==0 means ready. Process present and wait0 ==0x102 means still running. Other process result or missing handle is not running for this branch. Wait only while not ready, process running and unsigned tick difference below60000.

Terminal branch kills timer, closes existing process/event handles and zeroes both slots. Ready plus running and non-null app/virtual-slot0x74 retrieval checks requests WM_CLOSE0x10 via PostMessageA; other terminal states call window helpers and show failure. The virtual pointer is retrieved again; actual window receiver/exit is not observed. Destructor also kills timer and closes held handles. Handle closure is not child termination or update commit.

Open parent by request PID using access0x101000 then fallback0x100400. Dynamically query QueryFullProcessImageNameW, resolve GetFullPathNameW within260WCHAR and trim trailing separators above length3, then compare with the requested target using __wcsicmp. Failure closes and zeroes handle. This is path comparison, not final-file or publisher authentication. Raw AL return/caller tests corroborate the default-void pseudocode.

Selected normal path follows request validation, named transaction-mutex existence guard and parent check. It obtains parent creation FILETIME and formats the same PID/high/low event name. OpenEventW uses2, no inheritance; successful open is SetEvent then CloseHandle. Missing event with last error2 follows compatibility fallback without signaling; other failures abort this branch.
facts.format_argument_stack_proof: Creation FILETIME at entry-SP+0x20/+0x24; formatter varargs PID fromSP+0x18, high, low observed at4077e1..407801.

facts.claim: After signal success or missing-event compatibility fallback, wait at most60000ms for the parent. Close parent handle, require wait result0, then invoke unfinished-transaction recovery and proceed toward later update work. Readiness occurs before those operations, so it cannot be reused as a completed-update or child-start ACK.

interpretation_limits: Truth table summarizes static branch decisions, not an executed vendor test or proof of asynchronous race behavior
Unsigned DWORD subtraction has wrap semantics; no monotonic JavaScript deadline substitution is asserted
The two observed60000ms waits and100ms polling period do not establish whole-update time limits
Named event and path checks do not establish account authentication or publisher identity
Replacement, new-child startup acknowledgement, commit and recovery acceptance remain separate

product_decision.reason: This is a Win32 process/named-event lifecycle contract. The current web/mobile/WeChat architecture has no such executor port; no unused execution helper or guessed browser equivalence is added. Existing pure argument encoder and journal parser remain unchanged.
